svg.title: MediaLog — Glass book
svg.desc: A translucent open book turns slowly in space. Where its pages overlap, the glass deepens, like a glenz object from a nineties demo. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The rotating glenz solid becomes a six-leaf open book with a tan ribbon, projected in true perspective; Translucent navy faces deepen where they overlap on light pages; on dark pages they brighten like glass.
